local OrionLib = loadstring(game:HttpGet(('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shlexware/Orion/main/source')))()
local Window = OrionLib:MakeWindow({Name = "Op script", HidePremium = false, SaveConfig = true, ConfigFolder = "orangutag"})
local Tab = Window:MakeTab({
	Name = "Main",
	Icon = "rbxassetid://4483345998",
	PremiumOnly = false
})
local Section = Tab:AddSection({
	Name = "Auto win"
})
OrionLib:MakeNotification({
	Name = "notification :)",
	Content = "Thank you using my script :)",
	Image = "rbxassetid://4483345998",
	Time = 7
})
Tab:AddButton({
	Name = "safe place [runners and jungle gym]",
	Callback = function()
      		--[[
	WARNING: Heads up! This script has not been verified by ScriptBlox. Use at your own risk!
]]
game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(14, 141, 16)
  	end 
})  
Tab:AddButton({
	Name = "safe place[towers and runners]",
	Callback = function()
      		--[[
	WARNING: Heads up! This script has not been verified by ScriptBlox. Use at your own risk!
]]
game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(20, 238, 45)
  	end    
})
Tab:AddButton({
	Name = "auto win[taggers",
	Callback = function()
      		local plrs = game:GetService("Players")
local lp = plrs.LocalPlayer
local char = lp.Character or lp.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local pos = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart").CFrame

for _, p in pairs(plrs:GetPlayers()) do
    if p ~= lp and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = pos
    end
end
  	end    
})
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

Tab:AddTextbox({
	Name = "Teleport to Player",
	Default = "",
	TextDisappear = true,
	Callback = function(inputName)
		if not LocalPlayer.Character then return end

		local targetPlayer = nil
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if string.find(string.lower(player.Name), string.lower(inputName)) then
				targetPlayer = player
				break
			end
		end

		if targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character then
			local targetRoot = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local localRoot = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if targetRoot and localRoot then
				localRoot.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame
			end
		end
	end
})
